title: Chinese cancer drug to go on sale in US after Americans travel to buy it
text:
‘Saved my mum’s life’: Chinese cancer drug on sale in US after Americans travel to buy it | South China Morning Post US - US Chinese cancer drug to go on sale in US after Americans travel to buy it 13 Advertisement US-China relations US ‘Saved my mum’s life’: Chinese cancer drug on sale in US after Americans travel to buy it 
 AstraZeneca moves to make the lung cancer treatment available in the United States after lengthy delays raised concerns over patient access
 4 -MIN READ 4 -MIN 13 Listen Nayan Seth in Washington Published: 5:56am, 23 Oct 2026 Updated: 11:12am, 23 Oct 2026 Global pharmaceutical firm AstraZeneca on Thursday said it would start selling a cancer drug after coming under criticism for failing to bring it to the US market faster, prompting some Americans to fly to Shanghai to procure the potentially life-saving medicine first developed by China.
 In recent months, desperate Americans have travelled to China to obtain the Chinese-made cancer drug that was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration but remained unavailable in the country for more than a year, according to a cancer-treatment awareness advocate who made the journey while his mother was battling the disease.
 “I’m very thankful to all the development that companies in China have done because it saved my mum’s life,” Max Doppelt, chief executive of Patient Data Vault, a consultancy that connects cancer patients to clinical trials, told the South China Morning Post.
 Developed by China’s Dizal Pharmaceutical, sunvozertinib is a targeted lung cancer drug designed to treat adults with an advanced form of the illness, offering another treatment option for patients.
